We need to determine charges based on facts. Facts: Husband repeatedly beats wife, on June 26 2016 he beat her with fists, car key, etc, causing injuries (light injuries level 2). Then she fell into river and drowned. Injuries were before death, cause of death includes neck compression (strangulation) and blunt force. So cause of death is homicide due to intentional assault leading to death. Likely charge:故意杀人 (intentional homicide) or perhaps故意伤害致死 (intentional injury causing death). Chinese criminal law: If the act is intentional assault causing death, can be charged with故意伤害致死 (intentional injury resulting in death) which is a separate offense, but often considered as homicide. Also domestic violence:虐待家庭成员 (abuse of family member). The prosecution mentions故意伤害他人，致人轻伤，并虐待家庭成员，情节恶劣，致使死亡. So charges:故意伤害致死 (or故意杀人) and虐待家庭成员. Need to follow correction rules: "When a single conduct simultaneously satisfies the elements of a higher‑level offense (e.g., rape) and also matches lower‑level offenses, ...". Here higher-level offense is homicide (故意杀人) which includes intentional injury causing death. So we should charge the higher-level offense, not the lower-level. So charge:故意杀人 (or perhaps故意伤害致死). Chinese law: Article 232 for intentional homicide. Also domestic violence:《刑法》第二百七十七条? Actually "虐待家庭成员" is a crime under Article 260? Not sure. But we can list "虐待家庭成员". So final answer: [罪名]故意杀人;虐待家庭成员<eoa>
